given: three synthetic crew members, a supervisor and an administrator
one ambulance with two identical kits, overlapping inspection windows, and a zero-kit control vehicle
when: crew check concurrently and replay a lost response
Pass and Fail race, a warning is acknowledged, and author corrections and administrator invalidations follow
a supervisor completes Unable to Inspect, crew record odometer readings, and kit instances change mid-window
a session auto-closes after six hours and is reopened

T1/T2/T3 historical reads equal shuffled event replay after later events
a committed check update is delivered in-process and external networking is blocked
